name: gmo-onair
description: GMO ONAiR - 統合業務管理システム

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,daily,equipment,server -c blue,yellow,cyan,green "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w client-daily" "npm run dev -w client-equipment" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n client,equipment,qsheet,techsheet,live,awards,daily,server -c blue,cyan,magenta,white,red,orange,yellow,green "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w client-equipment" "npm run dev -w client-qsheet" "npm run dev -w client-techsheet" "npm run dev -w client-live" "npm run dev -w client-awards" "npm run dev -w client-daily" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.dev:frozen: concurrently -n qsheet,techsheet,live,awards,server -c magenta,white,red,orange,green "npm run dev -w client-qsheet" "npm run dev -w client-techsheet" "npm run dev -w client-live" "npm run dev -w client-awards" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.typecheck: concurrently -m 3 -n client,daily,equipment "npx tsc -b client" "npx tsc -b client-daily" "npx tsc -b client-equipment" && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.typecheck:all: concurrently -m 4 -n client,equipment,qsheet,techsheet,live,awards,daily "npx tsc -b client" "npx tsc -b client-equipment" "npx tsc -b client-qsheet" "npx tsc -b client-techsheet" "npx tsc -b client-live" "npx tsc -b client-awards" "npx tsc -b client-daily" && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w client-daily && npm run build -w client-equipment && npm run build -w server
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w client-equipment && npm run build -w client-qsheet && npm run build -w client-techsheet && npm run build -w client-live && npm run build -w client-awards && npm run build -w client-daily && npm run build -w server
scripts.build:render: cd client && npx vite build && cd ../client-equipment && npx vite build && cd ../client-qsheet && npx vite build && cd ../client-techsheet && npx vite build && cd ../client-live && npx vite build && cd ../client-awards && npx vite build && cd ../client-daily && npx vite build && cd ../server && npx tsc && mkdir -p dist/shared/db && cp -r src/shared/db/migrations dist/shared/db/
scripts.lint: node scripts/check-fonts-vendored.mjs && node scripts/check-tokens.mjs && node scripts/check-shared-wiring.mjs && node scripts/check-file-size.mjs && node scripts/check-ui-tokens.mjs && node scripts/check-mobile-declared.mjs && eslint .
